shared_elements: straight-line strokes with angled branches (rune-like characters)
inscribed lines on a stone surface
justification: Both surfaces bear incised angular, stroke-and-branch characters of the same general script-like family, drawn with plain thin lines and no infill. A shows a fully organised composition — a framing border of text bands around the slab edges and a large arched/cross-shaped internal figure carrying further characters — whereas B shows only a short, irregular row of similar signs with no framing, figure or evident layout, so the correspondence rests on the character forms alone.
